blocker.requirement: Preserve vector accents and Greek alpha through an existing valid math-label feature, without renderer changes or hand-rendered SVG.
blocker.observedContract: The current schema lists text but no math-label object or notation contract. validate_spec.py has no mathematical-label support. render_spec.mjs addLabel records a plain text string; the label loop assigns node.textContent and Arial/Helvetica rather than rendering mathematical notation.
blocker.whyNoFallback: Plain Unicode or raw LaTeX labels are not the required feature. Undocumented object properties would be ignored. Constructing accent SVG or changing/copy-patching the renderer is explicitly forbidden.
blocker.requiredExternalChange: Provide the path/contract for an already-existing compliant math-label implementation, or arrange a separately authorized tool change. This author does not perform that change.

displayPlan.widthContractBasis: User-authorized current D026 usable-width minimum 310px, with 331/342px mobile and 480px capped desktop composition. This is a proposed contract, not a new app measurement.

attempts.reason: Stopped at required-feature preflight, before fabricating a spec or spending the one figure repair.
